story: An icon of the skies, the African Crowned Eagle (Stephanoaetus coronatus) is a species from the Accipitridae family. It thrives in Forests; woodlands; savanna; shrubland; plantations; and urban greenspaces, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Near Threatened (NT), the African Crowned Eagle is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the African Crowned Eagle helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the African Crowned Eagle, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
